core_outcome: Pure synthetic clock-event processing -> explicit anomaly set -> owner-approved payable segments -> deterministic snapshot value and hash, usable by later schema/services.
must_pass_gates: Same employee/workplace and idempotency key with identical payload returns the same event; conflicting payload fails explicitly.
IN then OUT retains exact UTC integer milliseconds; no mutation of original event history.
Competing commands use explicit expected revision: stale revision conflicts. Pure tests prove conflict semantics only; actual DB concurrency remains W2/W3 integration evidence.
OUT without IN, repeated IN, missing OUT, reversed/zero duration, duplicate event IDs and overlapping intervals produce stable errors or blocking exceptions; never silently fabricate work.
Out-of-schedule, public-holiday and 22:00-06:00 local work are explicit exceptions, including intervals crossing midnight and local calendar boundaries.
Shop timezone is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; timestamps are raw UTC milliseconds; local time derives from explicit context without system clock or host timezone.
Six-hour and ten-hour approved shifts keep the whole duration including paid breaks; 59/60/61 second durations remain exact.
Only explicitly approved payable intervals appear in payable outputs. Full-time variance never emits automatic monetary deductions.

Snapshot construction rejects unresolved exceptions and unapproved/overlapping/out-of-period or mismatched employee/workplace segments. Supplied approval metadata is synthetic domain input, not authenticated authorization proof.
Reordering semantically unordered input records gives the same snapshot hash; changing an approved millisecond, classification or approver changes it. Snapshot is detached and immutable.
Attendance unit tests, payroll regressions, attendance-inclusive typecheck and scoped diff check pass.

interface_decisions.time: UTC epoch milliseconds within JS safe integer/Date range, validate integer before arithmetic; duration as bigint; canonical JSON encodes bigint as decimal strings.
interface_decisions.transitions: acceptClockCommand receives immutable state, typed command, explicit event ID/timestamp and expected revision; returns accepted/replayed/conflict result. No I/O, clock or hidden persistence.
interface_decisions.ordering: Never reorder commands to repair impossible sequences. Canonical sorting applies only to unordered snapshot collections.
interface_decisions.schedules: Explicit effective schedule intervals and holiday local-date context are inputs. Missing context fails visibly. Store opening-pattern versions and schedule commands in W3-01b, not here.
interface_decisions.intervals: Half-open [start,end), positive duration; adjoining intervals do not overlap. Night boundaries are local 22:00 inclusive and 06:00 exclusive.
interface_decisions.snapshot: Pure prevalidated value builder; no database finalization, signature authentication or owner permission enforcement claim.

rollback: Preserve scoped uncommitted changes for review; no reset/delete. Parent may restore only its exact package.json script edit from the recorded pre-edit content after confirming no user change.
cleanup: Finite commands must exit; both native children must finish or be interrupted by parent at their bound. No detached services. Parent owns commit, never push.
